silhouette.reason: Red crest, big red pauldrons, carbine and backpack radio read "infantry" in the 3/4 views; in the front view the carbine points at the camera and nearly vanishes, and the stiff straight-arm stance is generic.
fixes: carry the carbine at port arms across the chest so it reads from the front as well
a longer crest tail for the back view

proportions.reason: 1.3 x 0.8 x 2.0 m, a chunky ~6-head figure; legs and pauldrons read at RTS scale. The head and hands are small next to the pauldrons for a 64 px read.
fixes: head and hands ~10% bigger for the RTS read

materials.reason: Bone ceramic armour, olive canvas undersuit, brown leather boots and gunmetal carbine separate in hero.png; in sheet.png the boots and gloves render pale blue-grey/white, and every surface has the same soft plastic sheen.
fixes: rougher matte canvas versus glossier ceramic armour (roughness contrast)
check the leather role on boots/gloves: pale blue-grey in sheet.png

detail.reason: Visor, crest, chest plates, red stripe, knee pads, belt and radio pack with antenna; the body is blocky low-poly limbs with no webbing, pouches or panel lines visible at hero distance.
fixes: webbing straps and magazine pouches on the chest
panel lines on the torso shell
rounder limb cross-sections (8 sides) at LOD0

wear.reason: weather() chips, dust and mud are measured, but at hero distance the figure reads clean; boots carry no visible mud.
fixes: stronger mud on boots and shins, scuffs on knee pads visible at hero distance

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 (348 tris) keeps crest, pauldrons, carbine and team colour; boots become blue-grey blocks.
fixes: keep the boot colour consistent between LODs

technical.reason: QA PASS (rebuilt today): 12.1k / 2.6k / 348 tris, 3 / 3 / 3 draws; triangles mostly on the head and carbine.
fixes: spend fewer LOD0 triangles on the carbine barrel rings and more on rounder limbs
